paragraphs: The Z4 sDrive35is was the range-topping petrol variant of the E89-generation Z4, produced from 2009 to 2016. It uses the N54 — a 3.0-litre twin-turbo straight-six that sits above the naturally aspirated engines in the range and delivers substantially more power. The N54 is a well-known engine across BMW's performance-oriented models of this era, with a distinct set of components and known wear points that differ from both the naturally aspirated N52 and the later single-turbo N55.
about.boldParagraph: The Z4 sDrive35is is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

compatibility.intro: The Z4 sDrive35is uses the N54 engine exclusively across its entire production run. It's a different engine from the naturally aspirated N52 found in the sDrive23i and sDrive30i, and different again from the later single-turbo N55 used in the sDrive35i.
